q: 我们下午去___博物馆。
zh: 我们下午去参观博物馆。
py: wǒ men xià wǔ qù cān guān bó wù guǎn
en: We're visiting the museum this afternoon.
why: Looking round a place such as a museum is 参观. 看望 is for people, and 访问 is an official visit.

q: 这双鞋很___我，不大也不小。
zh: 这双鞋很适合我，不大也不小。
py: zhè shuāng xié hěn shì hé wǒ bú dà yě bù xiǎo
en: These shoes suit me; they're neither too big nor too small.
why: An object (我) follows, so the verb 适合. 合适 is an adjective and cannot take an object.

q: 这次汉语考试很难，可是我___了。
zh: 这次汉语考试很难，可是我通过了。
py: zhè cì hàn yǔ kǎo shì hěn nán kě shì wǒ tōng guò le
en: This Chinese exam was hard, but I passed.
why: Passing a test is 通过. 经过 would mean going through or past something and does not say you succeeded.

q: 这本书的语言太难了，我看了三遍还是看不___。
zh: 这本书的语言太难了，我看了三遍还是看不懂。
py: zhè běn shū de yǔ yán tài nán le wǒ kàn le sān biàn hái shi kàn bù dǒng
en: The language in this book is so hard that I've read it three times and still can't understand it.
why: Not grasping a hard text is 看不懂. 看不清楚 would mean the print is too small or blurry, which is not what 太难了 describes.

s: 我回家的时候通过一家书店，买了一本书。
s_py: wǒ huí jiā de shí hou tōng guò yì jiā shū diàn mǎi le yì běn shū
zh: 我回家的时候经过一家书店，买了一本书。
py: wǒ huí jiā de shí hou jīng guò yì jiā shū diàn mǎi le yì běn shū
en: On my way home I passed a bookshop and bought a book.
why: Going past a shop is 经过. 通过 means 'by means of' or 'pass a test'.

q: 这家餐厅的价格很___，我们就在这儿吃吧。
zh: 这家餐厅的价格很合适，我们就在这儿吃吧。
py: zhè jiā cān tīng de jià gé hěn hé shì wǒ men jiù zài zhè r chī ba
en: The prices at this restaurant are reasonable; let's eat here.
why: No object follows, and 很 sits before it as an adjective: 很合适. 适合 is a verb and needs an object.

q: 这套房子大小正___，离地铁站也不远。
zh: 这套房子大小正合适，离地铁站也不远。
py: zhè tào fáng zi dà xiǎo zhèng hé shì lí dì tiě zhàn yě bù yuǎn
en: This flat is just the right size, and it's not far from the subway station either.
why: Nothing follows the blank, so the adjective 合适: 大小正合适 'just the right size'. 适合 is a verb and needs an object (正适合我们), so 大小正适合 is left hanging.

s: 关于他来说，这个工作太累了。
s_py: guān yú tā lái shuō zhè ge gōng zuò tài lèi le
zh: 对于他来说，这个工作太累了。
py: duì yú tā lái shuō zhè ge gōng zuò tài lèi le
en: For him, this job is too tiring.
why: 'For him' is 对于他来说. 关于 only names a topic and never pairs with 来说.

q: 这个消息太___了，我一点准备也没有。
zh: 这个消息太突然了，我一点准备也没有。
py: zhè ge xiāo xi tài tū rán le wǒ yì diǎn zhǔn bèi yě méi yǒu
en: This news is so sudden; I had no preparation at all.
why: 太突然了 uses 突然 as an adjective. 忽然 is only an adverb before a verb, so 太忽然了 is wrong.

s: 我们打算去云南旅行。
s_py: wǒ men dǎ suàn qù yún nán lǚ xíng
zh: 我们打算去云南旅行。
py: wǒ men dǎ suàn qù yún nán lǚ xíng
en: We plan to travel to Yunnan.
why: 去 + place + 旅行 is correct: 旅行 takes no place object of its own but follows 去 + place.

q: 他___了很多困难，才成了一名医生。
zh: 他经历了很多困难，才成了一名医生。
py: tā jīng lì le hěn duō kùn nan cái chéng le yì míng yī shēng
en: He went through many difficulties before he became a doctor.
why: 'Go through' is the verb 经历, followed by 了 and an object. 经验 is only a noun and cannot take 了.

q: 他做了一个很___的决定，大家都很吃惊。
zh: 他做了一个很突然的决定，大家都很吃惊。
py: tā zuò le yí gè hěn tū rán de jué dìng dà jiā dōu hěn chī jīng
en: He made a very sudden decision, and everyone was surprised.
why: Before 的 + noun only the adjective 突然 works. 忽然 cannot modify a noun.

q: 你先去挂号，___再去二楼检查。
zh: 你先去挂号，然后再去二楼检查。
py: nǐ xiān qù guà hào rán hòu zài qù èr lóu jiǎn chá
en: First go and register, then go to the second floor for the examination.
why: 先 … 然后 marks the next step in a sequence of instructions. 后来 only tells a past story and cannot be used in a command.

s: 昨天晚上我又没睡好。
s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ yòu méi shuì hǎo
zh: 昨天晚上我又没睡好。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ yòu méi shuì hǎo
en: I didn't sleep well again last night.
why: It already happened (昨天晚上), so 又 is right even with 没. 再 would be for the future.

q: 他的声音太小了，我没听___。
zh: 他的声音太小了，我没听清楚。
py: tā de shēng yīn tài xiǎo le wǒ méi tīng qīng chu
en: His voice was too quiet; I couldn't hear him clearly.
why: Whether a sound is clear to the ear is 清楚. 懂 and 明白 are about grasping the meaning, which is not the problem when the voice is too quiet to hear.

q: 你___电影院在哪儿吗？
zh: 你知道电影院在哪儿吗？
py: nǐ zhī dào diàn yǐng yuàn zài nǎ r ma
en: Do you know where the cinema is?
why: 知道 takes a fact or a clause such as 电影院在哪儿. 认识 is for people, characters and roads, and 了解 means knowing something in depth; neither takes a where-clause.

q: 我们暑假去云南___，那里的天气很好。
zh: 我们暑假去云南旅游，那里的天气很好。
py: wǒ men shǔ jià qù yún nán lǚ yóu nà lǐ de tiān qì hěn hǎo
en: We're going to Yunnan on holiday this summer; the weather there is lovely.
why: A holiday trip is 去 + place + 旅游. 参观 needs a place to look round as its object, and 看望 needs a person.

q: 十年前我们是邻居，___他搬走了，我们就没再见过面。
zh: 十年前我们是邻居，后来他搬走了，我们就没再见过面。
py: shí nián qián wǒ men shì lín jū hòu lái tā bān zǒu le wǒ men jiù méi zài jiàn guo miàn
en: Ten years ago we were neighbours; later he moved away and we haven't met since.
why: 后来 opens the next stage of a past story. A bare 以后 at the start of a clause would mean 'from now on', which does not fit a story about ten years ago.

q: 你能___我一个忙吗？
zh: 你能帮我一个忙吗？
py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yí gè máng ma
en: Could you do me a favour?
why: 帮 + person + (一个)忙 is the split form of 帮忙. 帮忙 already contains 忙, so 帮忙我一个忙 repeats it, and 帮助我一个忙 is not said.

q: ___我来说，这首歌的意思很难懂。
zh: 对于我来说，这首歌的意思很难懂。
py: duì yú wǒ lái shuō zhè shǒu gē de yì si hěn nán dǒng
en: For me, the meaning of this song is hard to understand.
why: 'For me' is 对于我来说. 关于 only names a topic and never goes with 来说.

s: 他帮了我一个大忙。
s_py: tā bāng le wǒ yí gè dà máng
zh: 他帮了我一个大忙。
py: tā bāng le wǒ yí gè dà máng
en: He did me a big favour.
why: 帮忙 splits around the person and the measure word: 帮 + 了 + 我 + 一个大 + 忙. This is the correct way to give it an object.

s: 我认为很饿，我们去吃饭吧。
s_py: wǒ rèn wéi hěn è wǒ men qù chī fàn ba
zh: 我觉得很饿，我们去吃饭吧。
py: wǒ jué de hěn è wǒ men qù chī fàn ba
en: I feel very hungry; let's go and eat.
why: Hunger is a body feeling, so 觉得. 认为 is never used for body feelings.

q: 我们先坐地铁，___换公交车去机场。
zh: 我们先坐地铁，然后换公交车去机场。
py: wǒ men xiān zuò dì tiě rán hòu huàn gōng jiāo chē qù jī chǎng
en: We'll take the subway first, then change to a bus to the airport.
why: 先 … 然后 gives the next step of a plan. 后来 only looks back at a past story and cannot carry a plan or instruction.

q: 这个汉字我不___，你能念一下吗？
zh: 这个汉字我不认识，你能念一下吗？
py: zhè ge hàn zì wǒ bú rèn shi nǐ néng niàn yí xià ma
en: I don't recognise this character; can you read it out?
why: 认识 is the verb for recognising a character, a person or a road. 了解 is for knowing a topic or a person in depth and does not fit one character you cannot read.

q: 请___我拿一下这个箱子，好吗？
zh: 请帮我拿一下这个箱子，好吗？
py: qǐng bāng wǒ ná yí xià zhè ge xiāng zi hǎo ma
en: Please help me carry this suitcase for a moment, will you?
why: Everyday help with a task is 帮 + person + verb. 帮忙 takes no object, so 帮忙我拿 is wrong.

q: 我买了一本___北京地铁的书，里面有很多老照片。
zh: 我买了一本关于北京地铁的书，里面有很多老照片。
py: wǒ mǎi le yì běn guān yú běi jīng dì tiě de shū lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō lǎo zhào piàn
en: I bought a book about the Beijing subway, with many old photos in it.
why: 'A book about a topic' is 关于 + topic + 的 + noun. 对于 means 'towards' or 'as for' and does not introduce the subject of a book.

s: 周末我想去参观我的朋友。
s_py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qù cān guān wǒ de péng you
zh: 周末我想去看望我的朋友。
py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qù kàn wàng wǒ de péng you
en: At the weekend I want to go and see my friend.
why: 参观 is for places you look round. Visiting a person is 看望, or simply 看.

q: 下个月市长要___日本，跟几家大公司的老板见面。
zh: 下个月市长要访问日本，跟几家大公司的老板见面。
py: xià ge yuè shì zhǎng yào fǎng wèn rì běn gēn jǐ jiā dà gōng sī de lǎo bǎn jiàn miàn
en: Next month the mayor will visit Japan and meet the heads of several big companies.
why: An official visit to a country is 访问. 参观日本 would mean looking round Japan like a sight, 旅游 takes no object, and 看望 is for people.

s: 这条路经过一座小桥，然后就到公园了。
s_py: zhè tiáo lù jīng guò yí zuò xiǎo qiáo rán hòu jiù dào gōng yuán le
zh: 这条路经过一座小桥，然后就到公园了。
py: zhè tiáo lù jīng guò yí zuò xiǎo qiáo rán hòu jiù dào gōng yuán le
en: This road goes past a small bridge, and then you're at the park.
why: 经过 is right for passing a place on the way, and 然后 links the next step.

q: 他在这个小区住了很多年，对邻居们都很___。
zh: 他在这个小区住了很多年，对邻居们都很了解。
py: tā zài zhè ge xiǎo qū zhù le hěn duō nián duì lín jū men dōu hěn liǎo jiě
en: He has lived in this neighbourhood for many years and knows all the neighbours well.
why: Knowing people well after years of living beside them is 了解, and only 了解 can follow 很. 很认识 and 很知道 are not Chinese.

q: 搬家那天，邻居们都来___了。
zh: 搬家那天，邻居们都来帮忙了。
py: bān jiā nà tiān lín jū men dōu lái bāng máng le
en: On the day we moved, all the neighbours came to help.
why: No person is mentioned, so the whole verb-object 帮忙 stands alone. 帮助 and 帮 both need someone to help.

q: 我在这座城市住了三十年，所以很___它的历史。
zh: 我在这座城市住了三十年，所以很了解它的历史。
py: wǒ zài zhè zuò chéng shì zhù le sān shí nián suǒ yǐ hěn liǎo jiě tā de lì shǐ
en: I've lived in this city for thirty years, so I know its history very well.
why: Knowing something in depth, and with 很, is 了解. 知道 and 认识 never take 很, so 很知道 and 很认识 are both wrong.

q: 在北京学习的这段___，我一辈子也不会忘。
zh: 在北京学习的这段经历，我一辈子也不会忘。
py: zài běi jīng xué xí de zhè duàn jīng lì wǒ yí bèi zi yě bú huì wàng
en: I will never forget my time studying in Beijing, as long as I live.
why: A period of life you went through and remember is 经历. 经验 is skill learned from practice, not a memory.

q: 看电影___，请把手机关掉。
zh: 看电影的时候，请把手机关掉。
py: kàn diàn yǐng de shí hou qǐng bǎ shǒu jī guān diào
en: Please turn your phone off while you're watching the film.
why: 'While watching' is the clause plus 的时候. 以前 would mean before the film and 以后 after it.

q: 这首歌很___晚上听，听着听着就想睡觉了。
zh: 这首歌很适合晚上听，听着听着就想睡觉了。
py: zhè shǒu gē hěn shì hé wǎn shang tīng tīng zhe tīng zhe jiù xiǎng shuì jiào le
en: This song is well suited to listening at night; you start to feel sleepy as you listen.
why: The verb 适合 takes the phrase 晚上听 as its object. The adjective 合适 cannot take an object after it.

q: 这个手机软件对学汉语的人很有___。
zh: 这个手机软件对学汉语的人很有帮助。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī ruǎn jiàn duì xué hàn yǔ de rén hěn yǒu bāng zhù
en: This phone app is very helpful for people who study Chinese.
why: 'Be helpful' is 有帮助, using 帮助 as a noun. 有帮忙 and 有帮 do not exist.

q: 他___我是医生，其实我是老师。
zh: 他以为我是医生，其实我是老师。
py: tā yǐ wéi wǒ shì yī shēng qí shí wǒ shì lǎo shī
en: He thought I was a doctor, but actually I'm a teacher.
why: 其实 reveals that his belief was false, so 以为. 觉得 would state an opinion that the rest of the sentence contradicts.

s: 天忽然下起了大雨，我们只好在地铁站里等了一会儿。
s_py: tiān hū rán xià qǐ le dà yǔ wǒ men zhǐ hǎo zài dì tiě zhàn lǐ děng le yí huì r
zh: 天忽然下起了大雨，我们只好在地铁站里等了一会儿。
py: tiān hū rán xià qǐ le dà yǔ wǒ men zhǐ hǎo zài dì tiě zhàn lǐ děng le yí huì r
en: It suddenly started pouring, so we had to wait in the subway station for a while.
why: 忽然 is a perfectly good adverb before a verb phrase like 下起了大雨. Only after 太 or before 的 would it fail.

q: 吃了药以后，我___头不疼了。
zh: 吃了药以后，我觉得头不疼了。
py: chī le yào yǐ hòu wǒ jué de tóu bù téng le
en: After taking the medicine, I feel my headache has gone.
why: A bodily sensation is 觉得. 认为 is never used for body feelings, and 以为 would suggest the feeling turned out false.

q: 电话是谁___的？
zh: 电话是谁发明的？
py: diàn huà shì shéi fā míng de
en: Who invented the telephone?
why: Creating a new thing such as the telephone is 发明. 发现 is for finding or noticing what already exists.

s: 谢谢你的帮，我找到房子了。
s_py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng wǒ zhǎo dào fáng zi le
zh: 谢谢你的帮助，我找到房子了。
py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù wǒ zhǎo dào fáng zi le
en: Thanks for your help; I've found a flat.
why: After 你的 the noun 'help' is 帮助. 帮 is a verb only.

s: 你认识他住在哪儿吗？
s_py: nǐ rèn shi tā zhù zài nǎ r ma
zh: 你知道他住在哪儿吗？
py: nǐ zhī dào tā zhù zài nǎ r ma
en: Do you know where he lives?
why: A where-clause is a fact, so 知道. 认识 takes a person, character or road, not a clause.

q: 我___太累了，想早点回家休息。
zh: 我觉得太累了，想早点回家休息。
py: wǒ jué de tài lèi le xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā xiū xi
en: I feel really tired and want to go home early to rest.
why: Feeling tired is 觉得. 认为太累了 is wrong because 认为 is a considered judgement, not a body feeling.

s: 下课后来我们去喝咖啡吧。
s_py: xià kè hòu lái wǒ men qù hē kā fēi ba
zh: 下课以后我们去喝咖啡吧。
py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men qù hē kā fēi ba
en: Let's go for a coffee after class.
why: 'After class' is clause + 以后. 后来 stands alone and only looks back at a past story.

q: 我___音乐会在今天，原来是明天。
zh: 我以为音乐会在今天，原来是明天。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi yīn yuè huì zài jīn tiān yuán lái shì míng tiān
en: I thought the concert was today, but it turns out it's tomorrow.
why: 原来 shows the belief was wrong, which is exactly what 以为 signals. 认为 and 觉得 state a view that you still hold.

q: 谢谢你的___，我现在好多了。
zh: 谢谢你的帮助，我现在好多了。
py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù wǒ xiàn zài hǎo duō le
en: Thank you for your help; I'm much better now.
why: After 的 the noun 'help' is 帮助. 帮 is only a verb and cannot be used as a noun, so 你的帮 is wrong.

q: 我___在北京住，现在住在上海。
zh: 我以前在北京住，现在住在上海。
py: wǒ yǐ qián zài běi jīng zhù xiàn zài zhù zài shàng hǎi
en: I used to live in Beijing; now I live in Shanghai.
why: 以前 on its own means 'in the past', which sets up the contrast with 现在. 以后 looks forward, and 后来 needs an earlier stage of a story before it.

q: 这部电影太好看了，下个月我们___去看一次吧。
zh: 这部电影太好看了，下个月我们再去看一次吧。
py: zhè bù diàn yǐng tài hǎo kàn le xià ge yuè wǒ men zài qù kàn yí cì ba
en: This film is so good; let's go and see it again next month.
why: A repeat planned for next month has not happened, so 再. 又 is for a repeat that has already taken place.

q: 老师说得很___，大家都听懂了。
zh: 老师说得很清楚，大家都听懂了。
py: lǎo shī shuō de hěn qīng chu dà jiā dōu tīng dǒng le
en: The teacher explained it very clearly, and everyone understood.
why: How clearly someone speaks is 清楚 after 得. 懂 is what the listener does, so 说得很懂 is wrong.

q: 我今天早上___钱包不见了，马上去了警察局。
zh: 我今天早上发现钱包不见了，马上去了警察局。
py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang fā xiàn qián bāo bú jiàn le mǎ shàng qù le jǐng chá jú
en: I found my wallet was missing this morning and went straight to the police station.
why: Noticing that something is already the case is 发现. 发明 means to invent something new.

q: 医生___，感冒的时候应该多喝水、多休息。
zh: 医生认为，感冒的时候应该多喝水、多休息。
py: yī shēng rèn wéi gǎn mào de shí hou yīng gāi duō hē shuǐ duō xiū xi
en: The doctor holds that when you have a cold you should drink lots of water and rest.
why: A professional judgement the speaker accepts is 认为. 以为 would say the doctor was mistaken, which nothing in the sentence suggests.

s: 关于这家电影院，我听过很多有意思的故事。
s_py: guān yú zhè jiā diàn yǐng yuàn wǒ tīng guo hěn duō yǒu yì si de gù shi
zh: 关于这家电影院，我听过很多有意思的故事。
py: guān yú zhè jiā diàn yǐng yuàn wǒ tīng guo hěn duō yǒu yì si de gù shi
en: I've heard lots of interesting stories about this cinema.
why: A 关于 phrase naming the topic can open the sentence: 'about this cinema'. This is the normal use of 关于.

q: 我走路去地铁站___，下起了雨。
zh: 我走路去地铁站的时候，下起了雨。
py: wǒ zǒu lù qù dì tiě zhàn de shí hou xià qǐ le yǔ
en: It started to rain while I was walking to the subway station.
why: Rain starting during the walk is clause + 的时候. 以前 and 以后 would put the rain before or after the walk.

q: 太晚了，别看电影了，明天___看吧。
zh: 太晚了，别看电影了，明天再看吧。
py: tài wǎn le bié kàn diàn yǐng le míng tiān zài kàn ba
en: It's too late; stop watching the film and watch it tomorrow.
why: Resuming tomorrow is a repeat still to come, so 再. 又 would need it to have happened already.

s: 这份工作对你很合适，你就接受吧。
s_py: zhè fèn gōng zuò duì nǐ hěn hé shì nǐ jiù jiē shòu ba
zh: 这份工作对你很合适，你就接受吧。
py: zhè fèn gōng zuò duì nǐ hěn hé shì nǐ jiù jiē shòu ba
en: This job is a good fit for you; just accept it.
why: 对你很合适 is correct: the person is introduced by 对, so 合适 needs no object of its own. 这份工作很适合你 would also work.

q: 老师___我们学好汉语，我们都很感谢她。
zh: 老师帮助我们学好汉语，我们都很感谢她。
py: lǎo shī bāng zhù wǒ men xué hǎo hàn yǔ wǒ men dōu hěn gǎn xiè tā
en: The teacher helps us learn Chinese well, and we are all grateful to her.
why: A person (我们) plus a verb phrase follows, so the verb is 帮助. 帮忙 takes no object, so 帮忙我们 is wrong.

q: 来北京的外国朋友都想___故宫。
zh: 来北京的外国朋友都想参观故宫。
py: lái běi jīng de wài guó péng you dōu xiǎng cān guān gù gōng
en: All the foreign friends who come to Beijing want to visit the Forbidden City.
why: A sight you look round takes 参观 as a direct verb. 旅游 never takes a place as its object, so 旅游故宫 is wrong.

s: 他通过努力，终于考上了大学。
s_py: tā tōng guò nǔ lì zhōng yú kǎo shàng le dà xué
zh: 他通过努力，终于考上了大学。
py: tā tōng guò nǔ lì zhōng yú kǎo shàng le dà xué
en: Through hard work, he finally got into university.
why: 通过 + means is correct: 'by means of effort'.

s: 我以为是周末，原来今天要上班。
s_py: wǒ yǐ wéi shì zhōu mò yuán lái jīn tiān yào shàng bān
zh: 我以为是周末，原来今天要上班。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi shì zhōu mò yuán lái jīn tiān yào shàng bān
en: I thought it was the weekend, but it turns out I have to work today.
why: 以为 is right because 原来 shows the belief was mistaken.

s: 我知道他，可是我们没见过面。
s_py: wǒ zhī dào tā kě shì wǒ men méi jiàn guo miàn
zh: 我知道他，可是我们没见过面。
py: wǒ zhī dào tā kě shì wǒ men méi jiàn guo miàn
en: I know who he is, but we've never met.
why: 知道 + person means knowing of him, not having met him, so it fits 没见过面. 认识 would be the choice if they had met.

q: 看了两个小时电影，我___眼睛很不舒服。
zh: 看了两个小时电影，我觉得眼睛很不舒服。
py: kàn le liǎng gè xiǎo shí diàn yǐng wǒ jué de yǎn jing hěn bù shū fu
en: After watching films for two hours, my eyes feel very uncomfortable.
why: Physical discomfort is 觉得. 认为 is for considered judgements and cannot report how your eyes feel.

s: 这个房子很合适我。
s_py: zhè ge fáng zi hěn hé shì wǒ
zh: 这个房子很适合我。
py: zhè ge fáng zi hěn shì hé wǒ
en: This flat suits me well.
why: 合适 is an adjective and cannot take an object. With 我 after it, use the verb 适合.

q: 我感冒一个星期了，今天___在发烧。
zh: 我感冒一个星期了，今天还在发烧。
py: wǒ gǎn mào yí gè xīng qī le jīn tiān hái zài fā shāo
en: I've had this cold for a week, and today I still have a fever.
why: The fever is a continuing state, so 还在 for 'still'. 又 is for a repeat and 再 for a future repeat; neither means 'still going on'.

q: 我听音乐___，不喜欢别人跟我说话。
zh: 我听音乐的时候，不喜欢别人跟我说话。
py: wǒ tīng yīn yuè de shí hou bù xǐ huan bié rén gēn wǒ shuō huà
en: When I'm listening to music, I don't like people talking to me.
why: Not liking interruptions while listening is 的时候. 听音乐以前 would be before listening, when there is no music to be interrupted.

q: 我不___明天的电影几点开始。
zh: 我不知道明天的电影几点开始。
py: wǒ bù zhī dào míng tiān de diàn yǐng jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ
en: I don't know what time tomorrow's film starts.
why: A fact, here a start time inside a question clause, is 知道. 了解 and 认识 cannot introduce a 几点 clause.

q: 我每天上班都___那家书店，有时候进去看看。
zh: 我每天上班都经过那家书店，有时候进去看看。
py: wǒ měi tiān shàng bān dōu jīng guò nà jiā shū diàn yǒu shí hou jìn qù kàn kan
en: I pass that bookshop on my way to work every day and sometimes go in.
why: Going past a place on the way is 经过. 通过 means 'by means of' or 'pass a test' and is not used for walking past a shop.

q: 昨天我___迟到了，老板很生气。
zh: 昨天我又迟到了，老板很生气。
py: zuó tiān wǒ yòu chí dào le lǎo bǎn hěn shēng qì
en: I was late again yesterday, and my boss was very angry.
why: Late again, and it already happened (昨天), so 又 with 了. 再 is for a repeat still to come.

q: 我想先___一下这家医院，再决定去不去。
zh: 我想先了解一下这家医院，再决定去不去。
py: wǒ xiǎng xiān liǎo jiě yí xià zhè jiā yī yuàn zài jué dìng qù bú qù
en: I want to find out about this hospital first, then decide whether to go.
why: Looking into something to learn it properly is 了解一下. 知道一下 and 认识一下 do not mean that; 认识一下 would be for meeting a person.

q: 过年的时候，我们回老家___爷爷奶奶。
zh: 过年的时候，我们回老家看望爷爷奶奶。
py: guò nián de shí hou wǒ men huí lǎo jiā kàn wàng yé ye nǎi nai
en: At New Year we go back to our home town to see my grandparents.
why: Visiting elderly relatives you care about is 看望. 参观 is for places and 访问 for official visits.

q: 请把电话号码写___，不然我认不出来。
zh: 请把电话号码写清楚，不然我认不出来。
py: qǐng bǎ diàn huà hào mǎ xiě qīng chu bù rán wǒ rèn bù chū lái
en: Please write the phone number clearly, or I won't be able to make it out.
why: Writing something so that it is easy to read is 写清楚. 写懂 and 写明白 do not describe handwriting.

s: 我认为你在家，原来你出去了。
s_py: wǒ rèn wéi nǐ zài jiā yuán lái nǐ chū qù le
zh: 我以为你在家，原来你出去了。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ zài jiā yuán lái nǐ chū qù le
en: I thought you were at home, but it turns out you'd gone out.
why: 原来 shows the belief was wrong, so 以为. 认为 states a judgement you still hold.

s: 他想帮忙我找房子。
s_py: tā xiǎng bāng máng wǒ zhǎo fáng zi
zh: 他想帮我找房子。
py: tā xiǎng bāng wǒ zhǎo fáng zi
en: He wants to help me find a flat.
why: 帮忙 already contains its own object 忙 and cannot take 我. Use 帮 + person + verb.

q: 他先在医院工作了两年，___去了大学教书。
zh: 他先在医院工作了两年，然后去了大学教书。
py: tā xiān zài yī yuàn gōng zuò le liǎng nián rán hòu qù le dà xué jiāo shū
en: He first worked in a hospital for two years, then went to teach at a university.
why: 先 sets up a sequence, and the next step is introduced by 然后. 以后 at the head of a clause looks ahead ('from now on') and does not answer 先.

s: 我很知道他的想法。
s_py: wǒ hěn zhī dào tā de xiǎng fa
zh: 我很了解他的想法。
py: wǒ hěn liǎo jiě tā de xiǎng fa
en: I understand his way of thinking very well.
why: 知道 never takes 很. Knowing someone's thinking well is 了解.

q: 吃完饭___，我们去公园走走吧。
zh: 吃完饭以后，我们去公园走走吧。
py: chī wán fàn yǐ hòu wǒ men qù gōng yuán zǒu zou ba
en: After dinner, let's go for a walk in the park.
why: After a clause (吃完饭) 'after' is 以后. 后来 and 然后 cannot be attached to the end of a clause.

q: ___我每天都要锻炼，不再整天看电视了。
zh: 以后我每天都要锻炼，不再整天看电视了。
py: yǐ hòu wǒ měi tiān dōu yào duàn liàn bú zài zhěng tiān kàn diàn shì le
en: From now on I'm going to exercise every day and not watch TV all day long.
why: Looking forward, 'from now on', is 以后 alone. 后来 only looks back at the past and 然后 means 'and then'.

s: 纸是中国人发现的。
s_py: zhǐ shì zhōng guó rén fā xiàn de
zh: 纸是中国人发明的。
py: zhǐ shì zhōng guó rén fā míng de
en: Paper was invented by the Chinese.
why: Paper did not exist until someone made it, so it was 发明 'invented'. 发现 is for finding something that was already there, like a star or a mistake.

q: 出门___，别忘了关窗户。
zh: 出门以前，别忘了关窗户。
py: chū mén yǐ qián bié wàng le guān chuāng hu
en: Before you go out, don't forget to close the windows.
why: 'Before going out' is the clause 出门 plus 以前. 以后 would mean after leaving, when it is too late to close the windows.

q: 这位医生___了我很大的忙，我想请他吃饭。
zh: 这位医生帮了我很大的忙，我想请他吃饭。
py: zhè wèi yī shēng bāng le wǒ hěn dà de máng wǒ xiǎng qǐng tā chī fàn
en: This doctor was a great help to me, and I want to take him out for a meal.
why: The split 帮了我很大的忙 is 帮 + 了 + person + 的 + 忙. 帮忙了我很大的忙 repeats 忙 and 帮助了我很大的忙 does not take 的忙.

q: 都半夜了，邻居家___在放音乐。
zh: 都半夜了，邻居家还在放音乐。
py: dōu bàn yè le lín jū jiā hái zài fàng yīn yuè
en: It's already midnight and the neighbours are still playing music.
why: The music has not stopped, so 还在 'still'. 再 looks ahead to a repeat that has not begun, and cannot describe something still going on.

s: 我是学生以前，住在北京。
s_py: wǒ shì xué sheng yǐ qián zhù zài běi jīng
zh: 我是学生的时候，住在北京。
py: wǒ shì xué sheng de shí hou zhù zài běi jīng
en: When I was a student, I lived in Beijing.
why: 'When I was a student' is 的时候. 以前 after the clause means 'before I was a student', which is not the meaning.

q: 学会游泳___，我每个周末都去游泳池。
zh: 学会游泳以后，我每个周末都去游泳池。
py: xué huì yóu yǒng yǐ hòu wǒ měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù yóu yǒng chí
en: After I learned to swim, I went to the pool every weekend.
why: Right after the clause 学会游泳 'after' is 以后. 后来 and 然后 stand on their own and never close a clause.

q: 我妈妈住院了，我周末去医院___她。
zh: 我妈妈住院了，我周末去医院看望她。
py: wǒ mā ma zhù yuàn le wǒ zhōu mò qù yī yuàn kàn wàng tā
en: My mum is in hospital, so I'm going to see her at the weekend.
why: Going to see someone you care about is 看望. 参观 is for places you look round, so 参观她 is wrong.

q: 这条路今天___堵车了，我们得绕路。
zh: 这条路今天又堵车了，我们得绕路。
py: zhè tiáo lù jīn tiān yòu dǔ chē le wǒ men děi rào lù
en: The traffic is jammed on this road again today; we'll have to take a detour.
why: A jam that is happening again, already a fact today, takes 又 with 了. 再 looks ahead and 还 means 'still'.

s: 他说得很懂，我们都听明白了。
s_py: tā shuō de hěn dǒng wǒ men dōu tīng míng bai le
zh: 他说得很清楚，我们都听明白了。
py: tā shuō de hěn qīng chu wǒ men dōu tīng míng bai le
en: He spoke very clearly, and we all understood.
why: How clearly someone speaks is 清楚 after 得. 懂 describes the listener's understanding and cannot follow 说得很.

q: 他是新来的医生，还没有什么___，请你多帮帮他。
zh: 他是新来的医生，还没有什么经验，请你多帮帮他。
py: tā shì xīn lái de yī shēng hái méi yǒu shén me jīng yàn qǐng nǐ duō bāng bang tā
en: He's a new doctor without much experience yet, so please help him out.
why: Know-how gained from doing a job is 经验. 经历 is what happened to you, so 没有经历 would say he has not been through anything.

s: 明天我又来看你。
s_py: míng tiān wǒ yòu lái kàn nǐ
zh: 明天我再来看你。
py: míng tiān wǒ zài lái kàn nǐ
en: I'll come and see you again tomorrow.
why: Tomorrow has not happened, so a repeat takes 再. 又 is for a repeat that has already happened.

q: 对不起，我___忘带钥匙了。
zh: 对不起，我又忘带钥匙了。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ yòu wàng dài yào shi le
en: Sorry, I've forgotten my keys again.
why: Forgetting happened already, so 又 with 了. 再 would need the forgetting to be still to come.

q: 你现在说这件事不太___。
zh: 你现在说这件事不太合适。
py: nǐ xiàn zài shuō zhè jiàn shì bú tài hé shì
en: It's not very appropriate for you to bring this up now.
why: Nothing follows as an object, and 不太 modifies an adjective: 不太合适. 适合 would need an object.

s: 他先买了票，然后进了电影院。
s_py: tā xiān mǎi le piào rán hòu jìn le diàn yǐng yuàn
zh: 他先买了票，然后进了电影院。
py: tā xiān mǎi le piào rán hòu jìn le diàn yǐng yuàn
en: He bought a ticket first, then went into the cinema.
why: 先 … 然后 links two steps in order, and it works for a past event too. 然后 starts its own clause here.

s: 这个决定太忽然了，我还没想好。
s_py: zhè ge jué dìng tài hū rán le wǒ hái méi xiǎng hǎo
zh: 这个决定太突然了，我还没想好。
py: zhè ge jué dìng tài tū rán le wǒ hái méi xiǎng hǎo
en: This decision is too sudden; I haven't made up my mind yet.
why: 太…了 needs an adjective, and only 突然 is one. 忽然 is only an adverb before a verb.

q: 我___楼上没有人住，原来住着一位老医生。
zh: 我以为楼上没有人住，原来住着一位老医生。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi lóu shàng méi yǒu rén zhù yuán lái zhù zhe yí wèi lǎo yī shēng
en: I thought no one lived upstairs, but it turns out an old doctor lives there.
why: 原来 reveals the belief was wrong, so 以为. 觉得 would present 'no one lives there' as an opinion that stays valid.

s: 请你又说一遍，我没听懂。
s_py: qǐng nǐ yòu shuō yí biàn wǒ méi tīng dǒng
zh: 请你再说一遍，我没听懂。
py: qǐng nǐ zài shuō yí biàn wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: Please say it again; I didn't understand.
why: A request asks for something still to come, so 再. 又 cannot go in a request.

q: 很高兴___你！
zh: 很高兴认识你！
py: hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ
en: Nice to meet you!
why: Getting acquainted with a person you are meeting now is 认识. 知道你 would only say you have heard of the person, so it cannot be a greeting.

q: 他上大学___，在一家音乐商店打工。
zh: 他上大学的时候，在一家音乐商店打工。
py: tā shàng dà xué de shí hou zài yì jiā yīn yuè shāng diàn dǎ gōng
en: When he was at university, he worked part-time in a music shop.
why: The English says 'when he was at university', a period of time: 的时候. 以前 would put the job before university and 以后 after it.

s: 出门时请带上钥匙。
s_py: chū mén shí qǐng dài shàng yào shi
zh: 出门时请带上钥匙。
py: chū mén shí qǐng dài shàng yào shi
en: Please take your keys when you go out.
why: 时 is the short, written form of 的时候 and attaches straight to the verb phrase. It is correct with no 的.

s: 这件事我不太清楚，你去问问他吧。
s_py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ bú tài qīng chu nǐ qù wèn wen tā ba
zh: 这件事我不太清楚，你去问问他吧。
py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ bú tài qīng chu nǐ qù wèn wen tā ba
en: I'm not too sure about this; go and ask him.
why: 我不太清楚 is the normal way to say you do not know the details of a matter. 清楚 here means 'clear in my mind', not 'clear to the eye'.

q: 回家___给我打个电话。
zh: 回家以后给我打个电话。
py: huí jiā yǐ hòu gěi wǒ dǎ ge diàn huà
en: Call me after you get home.
why: 'After getting home' is the clause 回家 plus 以后. 后来 is past-only and 然后 cannot be attached to a clause.

q: 他看不___黑板上的字，所以坐到了前面。
zh: 他看不清楚黑板上的字，所以坐到了前面。
py: tā kàn bù qīng chu hēi bǎn shàng de zì suǒ yǐ zuò dào le qián miàn
en: He couldn't see the words on the blackboard clearly, so he moved to the front.
why: Moving to the front shows the problem is seeing, so 看不清楚. 看不懂 would mean he cannot grasp the meaning, which a seat would not fix.

q: 他在中国住了五年，当然___汉语。
zh: 他在中国住了五年，当然懂汉语。
py: tā zài zhōng guó zhù le wǔ nián dāng rán dǒng hàn yǔ
en: He has lived in China for five years, so of course he knows Chinese.
why: Knowing a language is 懂 plus the language. 明白汉语 and 清楚汉语 are not used for a language.
